title: Women's retailer led by influencer files Chapter 11 bankruptcy
summary: Back in 1993, Shoshanna Lonstein Gruss, then just Shoshanna Lonstein, became a tabloid darling because she dated Jerry Seinfeld at the height of his sitcom fame.
